notes:
- Lead inbound from product landing page; small engineering team, building web chat for SMB merchants.
- Primary complaint: perceived slowness and occasional timeouts for EU customers. Quote from founder: "Customers drop chat if reply >2s".
- Current setup: calling Redwood hosted_api default region (us-east). Traffic routed globally via client; no explicit region pinning in code.
- Usage pattern: short chat turns, product lookup calls with ~1.5k token context (customer message + product metadata). Cost sensitivity moderate.
- SE suggested quick wins: 1) region pinning by client IP (prefer eu-west for EU users), 2) reduce client timeout to 8s with graceful retry/backoff, 3) shorten system prompt and trim embeddings context to top-3 matches, 4) enable streaming to show tokens as they arrive.
- Customer asked: can we surface a simple "expected latency" map for regions and best timeout defaults? AE to send ASAP.
- Legal requested SOC2 summary and retention policy; provided security FAQ link but needs one-pager.
- They are self-serve but open to small POC; likely to convert to paid monthly if p95 < 800ms NA and <1.5s EU for chat flows.
